title: 上海供应链专家：贸易委员会300亿关税互减，消费者商品压力有望缓解？
speaker: Cameron Johnson

segments.en: That's right. I think one of the things is that this is a process. China has committed to buy
segments.zh: 没错。我认为这是一个过程。中国已承诺购买

segments.en: X amount of beans every year for the next couple of years. So I think that really is up to cycles of
segments.zh: 未来几年每年一定数量的豆类。所以这取决于采购周期。

segments.en: purchasing. I think when you actually talk about the board of trade, which is really $30 billion
segments.zh: 谈到贸易委员会，实际上是300亿美元

segments.en: for $30 billion on each side, taking away tariffs or at least MFN tariffs, most favorite nation,
segments.zh: 双方各300亿，取消关税或至少最惠国关税。

segments.en: that's really what we're looking at. And there's a lot of businesses here that are actually
segments.zh: 这就是我们关注的。很多企业实际上

segments.en: positive about that because it will take some of the bite out of the tariffs,
segments.zh: 对此持积极态度，因为这会减轻关税的冲击，

segments.en: particularly in consumer goods and electronics, which is, as you know, inflation here has become
segments.zh: 尤其是消费品和电子产品，如你所知，这里的通胀已成为

segments.en: a challenge. A non-sensitive issue. Non-sensitive, but I think the other thing that a lot of people
segments.zh: 一个挑战。非敏感问题。非敏感，但我认为很多人

segments.en: aren't realizing is it's good to have that communication. And again, we view this kind of as a floor.
segments.zh: 没有意识到的是，有这种沟通是好事。我们把这视为一个支撑。

segments.en: This is kind of the starting point. It's about 10% of trade over on the relationship.
segments.zh: 这是一个起点。约占贸易关系的10%。

segments.en: And now there will hopefully be more to come as they continue to look at those non-sensitive areas.
segments.zh: 希望随着他们继续关注非敏感领域，会有更多进展。
